welcome.title: Welcome to Agent World
welcome.body: Agent World orchestrates models, tools and quality gates into AI production lines that actually finish: the raw-material desk feeds in, workshops produce, the gate inspects, and the product library ships the output. Take a minute to learn the workspace.

raw.title: Raw-material desk · the input
raw.body: Write your material or task here; it becomes the input for the whole line.

toolbar.title: Workstation toolbar
toolbar.body: The text workshop generates, the quality gate checks, the image workshop draws, the API port connects external tools, and the product library collects output. Click once to add a workstation to the canvas.

canvas.title: Canvas and pipes
canvas.body: Wires between workstations show the direction material flows. Hover a workstation to see its type and model; toggle the nameplate from the Tips chip in the top bar.

dispatch.title: Dispatch task
dispatch.body: After assigning a model to the text workshop in Settings / Model assignment, click here to run the whole line.

inspector.title: Node configuration
inspector.body: Select any workstation to edit its prompt, model and parameters here; the quality gate's banned words and rules live here too.

hud.title: Results and global actions
hud.body: Run history shows every run and its cost; the review queue handles held output. Press ⌘K to open the command palette — and to replay this tour anytime.

finish.title: You're all set
finish.body: You've seen the whole line. Drop some material on the desk and dispatch your first run.
